answer: The sonnet graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the glacier audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 4 times its size, so a group of 86 keys loses far more than 86 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the island checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently.
